name: sintetica
description: SintéticaOS: firmware, formato compartido y simulador de Sintética Labs.

scripts.test: npm run test:formato && npm run test:nucleo && npm run test:sim
scripts.test:nucleo: cmake -S firmware -B build/nucleo -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build/nucleo -j && ctest --test-dir build/nucleo --output-on-failure
scripts.test:sim: sh sim/compilar.sh && node sim/empaquetar.mjs && node --test sim/test/sim.test.mjs
